market_summary: Stocks firmed into Wednesday: the S&P 500 rose 0.6% and the Nasdaq 1.1% on Oct 21 after chips snapped their 8-day losing streak on Oct 19 (SOX up about 2.7% that day). Tesla beat on EPS ($0.48 vs $0.44) and free cash flow ($1.5B vs an expected outflow) but slightly missed on revenue, and the stock was roughly flat to up 0.5% after hours; Lam Research fell 6% after hours despite a beat, while TXN guided Q4 above estimates and IBM rose about 3% late. The backdrop is still tight: the US 10-year is about 5.14%, Brent is near $109 after touching $112 on unverified Iranian claims that mines hit tankers in Hormuz, and futures price only about a 17% chance of a Fed hike this month but about 90% by December. Next: Spotify Q3 Thu night AEDT (before US open), FOMC decision Thu Oct 29 05:00 AEDT (meeting Oct 27-28), Alphabet and Microsoft Thu Oct 29 AEDT, BYD Q3 results Oct 29, Amazon Fri Oct 30 AEDT.

AMZN.reason: Up 5% since Oct 16 after Morgan Stanley made it a top pick on faster AWS growth. Q3 results Fri Oct 30 ~7am AEDT.

AXOS.reason: Up 2% since Oct 16 with no company news. Fiscal Q1 results Fri Oct 30 ~7am AEDT.

BABA.reason: Down 4% since Oct 16 as US-listed China tech sold off on Oct 21. China Q3 GDP grew 4.5%, a touch above forecasts, but consumer spending is still weak.

ENPH.reason: Up 4% since Oct 16 with no company news. Q3 results Wed Oct 28 ~7am AEDT are the next test.

FIGR.reason: Down 7% since Oct 16 with no company-specific news found. Thesis rests on marketplace volume, which doubled year on year in Q3.

GOOGL.reason: Down 2% since Oct 16 as investors trimmed before results; KeyBanc cut its target to $410 but kept Overweight. Q3 results Thu Oct 29 ~7am AEDT.

LDI.reason: Down 1% since Oct 16 with no new news. A 10-year near 5.1% keeps mortgage volumes under pressure; Q3 results estimated Nov 5 US time.

META.reason: Q3 revenue $64.6B (+26%) beat and the Q4 guide of $73-76B is at or above consensus; shares rose 3-5% after hours. Free cash flow went negative on $34.9B quarterly capex and a $9.9B legal charge.

MRVL.reason: Up 7% since Oct 16 as chip stocks bounced, regaining part of the slide after its Oct 6 investor day.

MU.reason: Up 4% since Oct 16. Taichung union signed a deal, but the Taoyuan union planned a one-day strike on Oct 22 Taiwan time; watch for any hit to output.

NFLX.reason: Down 8% since Oct 16 after Q3: EPS beat, but the 2026 ad revenue forecast was cut to $2.7B from $3B and layoffs were announced. Moved from hold to watch until ads get back on track.

NVDA.reason: Up 4% since Oct 16. At GTC Berlin, Huang pitched Europe's AI buildout, a fast-deploy DSX POD data center design and nearly $10B committed to Europe.

RKT.reason: Up 3% since Oct 16 with no company news. Q3 results expected around Oct 29 US time.

TSM.reason: Up 5% since Oct 16 as AI chip names bounced. Demand from Nvidia, Meta and other hyperscalers still looks firm.

STRIPE.reason: No new tender or round; the last mark is still the $159B tender from Feb 2026.

OPENAI.reason: Reuters said Oct 19 that talks on a ~$30B raise at over $1.4T are ongoing; not closed, so the mark stays at the $852B March round.

headlines: Meta Q3 revenue up 26% to $64.6B, Q4 guide $73-76B; up 3-5% after hours despite a $9.9B legal charge.
Netflix down 8% since Oct 16 after cutting its 2026 ad forecast to $2.7B; take moved from hold to watch.
Chips snapped an 8-day losing streak; holdings bounced: Marvell up 7%, Amazon and TSMC up 5% since Oct 16.
H100 rent hit a record $2.86/hr while CoreWeave bonds hold near 80c: compute still bid, financing still stressed.
Sea cut to watch/low after a 17% three-day drop on its cloud push and possible fintech IPO.
Next: Bloom Fri 08:00 AEDT; FOMC Thu Oct 29 05:00 AEDT; Alphabet and Microsoft Thu Oct 29; Amazon Fri Oct 30.
